name: 14416-batchdecode-minimaxm2-tp8
model: MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2 -- 230.2 GB of safetensors, ungated, and not in the local HF cache, so it downloads once before the first run.
parallelism: TP=8 with EP=8, PP=1, DP=1, one node. EP=8 is mandatory rather than a tuning choice: without it weight creation raises and the server does not start.
architecture: MiniMaxM2ForCausalLM, 62 layers, hidden 3072, 48 attention heads over 8 KV heads at head_dim 128, 256 routed experts top-8 at intermediate_size 1536, block-wise FP8 (weight_block_size [128, 128]), ~230B parameters of which ~10B are active per token, bf16 KV cache.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 320 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, no prefix buckets: prompts ~1536 tokens (stdev 384, clipped to [768, 2560]), outputs ~1024 (stdev 256, clipped to [512, 1536]), ignore_eos true and temperature 0.0, seed 42.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant on a large sparse-expert model, drafting page-length replies for 64 concurrent users across eight GPUs.
launch:
# sglang at commit ba67e006a71841b6aa6f2ee7b9824bf030a76f6a
#   (`git describe --tags` = v0.5.6.post2-656-gba67e006a71).

model-path: MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M2

# 230 GB does not go on fewer.
tp-size: 8

# MANDATORY rather than a tuning choice: expert width 1536 against a 128-wide FP8 quantization
# block. Under plain MoE tensor parallelism each rank holds 192 columns, 192 % 128 = 64, and
# weight creation rejects that with a hard ValueError before the first token -- the server does
# not start. With ep-size 8 each rank holds whole experts and 1536 % 128 == 0.
ep-size: 8

# The checkpoint ships an auto_map and its own tokenizer files.
trust-remote-code: true

mem-fraction-static: 0.85
